text.mi_ae2_pattern_provider.extended_pr: Processing Array Extended Pattern Supply Hatch
item.mi_ae2_pattern_provider.advanced_ov: Insert into the overdrive module slot of any MI electric machine.
Runs at maximum efficiency from the first tick and releases the recipe immediately - no recipe locking.
item.mi_ae2_pattern_provider.quantum_ove: Upgrade of the Advanced Overclock Module. Only goes into a Processing Array controller (the two are mutually exclusive).

Everything the Advanced Overclock Module does, plus %s times as many parallel batches as the machine count (still limited by input amounts and output slot space - it lowers the multiplier instead of voiding products).
item.mi_ae2_pattern_provider.guide.desc: Right-click to open the in-game guide.
message.mi_ae2_pattern_provider.quantum_: The Quantum Overclock Module only supports Processing Arrays
gui.mi_ae2_pattern_provider.rename_hint: Leave empty to restore the default name
mi_ae2_pattern_provider.configuration.qu: Multiplies the Processing Array's machine count for the parallel batch ceiling (64 machines -> 256 at 4x). The real batch is still clamped by available inputs and free output space, so a higher value can never void products - it just cannot always be reached. Applies to the next recipe calculation, no restart needed.
